# `Q-21-4` — Brand Font Not Available To Typst

> A `brand.typography.fonts` entry could not be made available to
> Typst, so Typst falls back to another font for that family.

## What this means

Typst only uses fonts that exist as files on disk. For a brand font
with `source: google`, Quarto downloads the font files when it renders
to Typst and caches them under `.quarto/typst/fonts` in the project
directory. This warning means that download did not produce a usable
font. The render still completes, using a fallback font.

## Why this happens

- The machine is offline, or `fonts.googleapis.com` /
  `fonts.gstatic.com` could not be reached.
- The family name is misspelled, so Google Fonts returned no font
  files for it.
- Google Fonts offered the family only as `woff`/`woff2`, which Typst
  cannot load. Typst needs TrueType or OpenType files.
- The font uses `source: bunny`, which Typst output does not support.

## How to fix

Check the network connection and the spelling of the family. Fonts
that downloaded once are cached and are not fetched again, so a later
offline render can still use them.

To avoid depending on the network, or to use a font Google does not
serve as TrueType/OpenType, supply the files yourself with
`source: file` in `typography.fonts`, or list their directory under
`font-paths`.
